## Instructions

- Mix the dry ingredients.
- Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla; beat 2 minutes.
- Stir in hot coffee; batter will be thin.
- Bake at 350°F, 30 to 35 minutes.
- Beat the icing and frost the cooled cake.

## Notes

Freezes well.

"Always a hit."
